rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial word for a person's lap or upper thighs when seated.

example.english: When you sit down, the dog always hides on your lap.
example.traditional: 你坐低嗰陣，隻狗成日匿喺你大髀上面。
example.jyutping: nei5 co5 dai1 go2 zan6 zek3 gau2 seng4 jat6 nik1 hai2 nei5 daai6 bei2 soeng6 min6

rows.note: Use this for one complete circuit of a running or other race track.

example.english: I ran one lap around the track and was already out of breath.
example.traditional: 我跑咗一圈賽道，已經攰到透氣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 paau2 zo2 jat1 hyun1 coi3 dou6 ji5 ging1 gui6 dou3 tau3 hei3

rows.note: Use this specifically for one length of a swimming pool in Hong Kong Cantonese.

example.english: I swam one lap today and was too tired to move.
example.traditional: 我今日游咗一塘，攰到唔想郁。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jau4 zo2 jat1 tong4 gui6 dou3 m4 soeng2 juk1
